description: Follow-up from bedrock-74j: decide whether the commit proxy should reject transactions touching keys at/beyond the last shard boundary (e.g. <<0xFF,0xFF>> system range) at ingress, rather than only failing them at finalization with storage_team_coverage_error. Larger design decision deliberately excluded from PR #87.

comments.text: FDB-source finding (2026-08-19, while validating q67.20.5/#151): FDB avoids deferred metadata accumulation entirely by verdict convergence — conflict ranges intersecting systemKeys are broadcast to ALL resolvers (CommitProxyServer.actor.cpp addRead/WriteConflictRanges), so every resolver holds full system-range conflict history and independently reaches the GLOBAL verdict for system-only-conflict transactions; the resolver's local committed flag then safely gates its stateMutations relay (Resolver.actor.cpp:397). This works only because FDB's metadata writers conflict exclusively in system space. If this ticket lands ingress rejection of user transactions touching system ranges AND system writes are required to carry system write-conflict ranges AND system-range conflicts are broadcast to all resolvers, then q67.17's hold/confirm protocol (q67.20.5) becomes retirable in favor of the simpler convergent design. Scope decision for this ticket + q67.9; #151 stays as-is meanwhile (it is correct for the general mixed-conflict case FDB does not handle).

Ingress half landed as PR #153 (stacked on #151, stack #149): out-of-range mutations rejected per-transaction at commit ingress with {:error,{:key_out_of_range,key}}; corrupt mutation payloads rejected as :invalid_transaction instead of crashing the proxy; Repo.transact surfaces both immediately (non-retryable). Cold-audit findings applied (retry classification, decode guard, corrected mechanism comment - single keys were silently fallback-routed to the last shard pre-fix, only clear_range past the boundary killed the epoch). Remaining scope on this ticket: the FDB-convergence question (system-write gating + system-range conflict broadcast) - see earlier comment; decide at q67.9 time.

Gap audit 2026-08-19 (vs ../foundationdb) upgrades the remaining scope from protocol-simplification question to INTEGRITY REQUIREMENT before q67.9 flips shard-map authority: (1) any client may write \xFF/system keys today and they flow into every proxy's routing table - FDB gates via ACCESS_SYSTEM_KEYS/lockAware (CommitProxyServer.actor.cpp:247-253); require privileged/system-flagged commits for \xFF writes. (2) Atomics on system keys silently diverge durable state from all metadata views: they pass ingress, are classified metadata mutations (transaction.ex:531), then skipped by Metadata and RoutingData while the materializer applies them durably - FDB transforms versionstamps to plain sets BEFORE the metadata check and handles no atomics in ApplyMetadataMutation; reject atomics targeting \xFF at ingress. Both fold into this ticket's next PR.

title: Commit proxy ingress validation for system-range keys
